storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Video Downloader makes it easy to save videos from virtually any website to your computer.

How it works: Visit any page with a video, click the extension icon or open the side panel, and SERP Video Downloader automatically detects all available videos. If multiple videos are found, pick the one you want from the candidate list. Select your preferred quality and hit Download — the video saves as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS (m3u8) streaming, DASH (mpd) manifests, and direct MP4 links automatically. Dedicated detectors for YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, Wistia, SproutVideo, and Skool provide deep integration with those platforms. For all other sites, the generic detector scans HTML5 video elements, source tags, and network requests to find every available stream.

Key features:
- Universal video detection — works on any website with video content
- Dedicated support for YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, Wistia, Sprout, and Skool
- Converts HLS and DASH streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Multi-video detection — finds all videos on a page and lets you choose
- In-page download manager with real-time progress and speed display
- Side panel mode for a persistent download interface
- Auto-downloads best quality for single-video pages
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Visit any page with a video
3. Click the extension icon or open the side panel
4. Select a video (if multiple found), pick quality, and download

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: What sites does this work on?
faq.answer: It works on virtually any website. Dedicated support for YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, Wistia, SproutVideo, and Skool, plus generic detection for any site with HTML5 video, HLS, or DASH streams.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the source. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with combined audio+video streams preferred. MP4 format is prioritized.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS and DASH streams are automatically converted to MP4.

faq.question: What if there are multiple videos on a page?
faq.answer: The extension detects all videos and shows a dropdown selector so you can choose which one to download.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Can I use my license from another SERP downloader?
faq.answer: Yes. Licenses from the SERP Downloaders Bundle, SERP Video Downloaders Bundle, or any individual SERP downloader (Vimeo, YouTube, Loom, Wistia, Skool, M3U8, and more) are accepted.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure the video has started playing or loading on the page. Some sites require the video to begin before streams are available. Refresh the page and try again if needed.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP email verification — no passwords stored.
